provenance.canonicalisation: RFC 8785 JCS via scripts/jcs.py; set hash is SHA-256 over JCS(vectors).
provenance.signatures: Ed25519 over domain || lowercase SHA-256 hex using fixed public test seeds; dependency-free RFC 8032 verifier.
provenance.status: candidate — no Demos runtime guarantee and no second-implementation cross-run yet
provenance.syntheticProofProfile: demos-bft-proof/test-1 fixtures define outputHash as SHA-256(JCS(storageOutput)), SHA-256(JCS(native transfer payload)), or SHA-256(JCS({accepted:true,operationId})); effectsRoot is SHA-256(JCS({pre,post})). These are test-only formulas, not production Demos wire claims.

coverage.note: Across the generated corpus, every applicable positive/negative/boundary cell of every rule ID has a rule-referenced fixture of the matching verdict class, and every non-applicable cell carries an explicit rationale; the generator and the strict validator both refuse a gap. Boundary cells count only boundaryRuleRefs. This gate counts rule references by class; it does not show that each fixture exercises its rule. Some cells are currently decided by self-reported or caller-supplied values, and strengthening them to the semantically meaningful fixtures CONFORMANCE-PLAN §14.8 requires remains open for this candidate.

vectors.name: aw-capability-authenticated
vectors.reason: Authenticated exact capability pins the execution profile, permits two business Works plus an audit tail, and supplies node rather than preflight authority.

vectors.name: aw-capability-mismatch-pre-sign-fallback
vectors.reason: Before signing, a missing/mismatched capability selects the existing lifecycle.

vectors.name: aw-capability-mismatch-no-fallback
vectors.reason: Atomic execution cannot begin under a mismatched capability.

vectors.name: aw-capability-wrong-authority
vectors.reason: A buyer-resigned attestation cannot substitute for the capability's authenticated network authority.

vectors.name: aw-capability-work-version-missing
vectors.reason: Capability admission requires Work v1 in the authenticated workVersions set.

vectors.name: aw-capability-authorization-algorithm-missing
vectors.reason: Capability admission requires the authorization algorithm actually used.

vectors.name: aw-capability-proof-profile-mismatch
vectors.reason: The authenticated capability proof profile must equal the selected profile.

vectors.name: aw-capability-proof-byte-limit-missing
vectors.reason: Authenticated Atomic capability limits include a positive maxProofBytes bound.

vectors.name: aw-capability-validator-set-empty
vectors.reason: The authenticated validator-set binding is non-empty and schema-validated.

vectors.name: aw-capability-fee-rule-unsupported
vectors.reason: A verifier rejects an authenticated fee rule it does not implement.

vectors.name: aw-capability-authorization-algorithm-duplicate
vectors.reason: Atomic v1 admits exactly one canonical Ed25519 algorithm entry.

vectors.name: aw-capability-closed-extension
vectors.reason: Unknown trust-gate members require a new capability version rather than open interpretation.

vectors.name: aw-capability-boolean-limit
vectors.reason: A JSON boolean cannot exploit Python integer equality in a capability limit.

vectors.name: aw-capability-evidence-string-not-nfc
vectors.reason: A cryptographically valid capability attestation still fails when a preserved signed member violates recursive CF-1 NFC.

vectors.name: aw-signed-atomic-stays-atomic
vectors.reason: After signing, an Atomic Work remains on the Atomic path under the authenticated capability.

vectors.name: aw-no-silent-fallback-after-sign
vectors.reason: A signed Atomic Work cannot silently fall back to a payment path.

vectors.name: aw-not-exactly-two-lifecycle-transactions
vectors.reason: The audit finalisation tail prevents an exactly-two lifecycle transaction claim.

vectors.name: aw-canonical-intent-and-id
vectors.reason: Pure JSON with unique ordered roles is JCS-canonicalized, and its exact canonical bytes are accepted only under the derived identifier.

vectors.name: aw-runtime-object-marker-rejected
vectors.reason: A runtime/SDK object marker is neither the closed pure-JSON intent shape nor portable signed data.

vectors.name: aw-safe-integer-max-accepted
vectors.reason: The inclusive RFC 8785 safe-integer maximum remains valid pure JSON.

vectors.name: aw-safe-integer-bound
vectors.reason: Unsafe JSON integers fail before canonicalization.

vectors.name: aw-negative-phase-index
vectors.reason: A phase index is a non-negative safe integer in schema and semantics.

vectors.name: aw-negative-expiry
vectors.reason: An expiry timestamp is a non-negative safe integer in schema and semantics.

vectors.name: aw-claim-parameters-canonical
vectors.reason: A CF-2 ClaimReference with sorted canonical parameters is accepted as signed bytes.

vectors.name: aw-claim-parameters-unsorted
vectors.reason: Unsorted ClaimReference parameters are rejected rather than silently repaired after signing.

vectors.name: aw-claim-identifier-not-nfc
vectors.reason: A non-NFC ClaimReference identifier is rejected before hashing.

vectors.name: aw-unknown-member-string-not-nfc
vectors.reason: CF-1 recursively rejects a non-NFC string even in a preserved unknown signed member.

vectors.name: aw-domain-claim-canonical-a-label
vectors.reason: The test CF-2 parser accepts a canonical lowercase domain A-label identifier.

vectors.name: aw-domain-claim-uppercase-rejected
vectors.reason: The test CF-2 parser rejects a domain identifier that violates DCR-1 lowercase canonical form.

vectors.name: aw-role-roster-order
vectors.reason: Role roster ordering is part of the deterministic wire contract.

vectors.name: aw-role-roster-duplicate
vectors.reason: A role cannot occur twice.

vectors.name: aw-required-role-order-and-unique
vectors.reason: Operation role requirements are canonical and unique.

vectors.name: aw-object-member-order-stable
vectors.reason: Object member insertion order does not affect JCS or workId; operation array order remains fixed.

vectors.name: aw-unknown-member-affects-id
vectors.reason: Unknown preserved unsigned members remain inside canonical Work bytes.

vectors.name: aw-transport-fields-outside-work-id
vectors.reason: Transport metadata outside the intent does not enter canonicalWorkBytes.

vectors.name: aw-claimed-id-mismatch
vectors.reason: Caller-supplied IDs are recomputed and mismatches rejected.

vectors.name: aw-different-id-identical-bytes
vectors.reason: Identical canonical bytes cannot be admitted under a second identity.

vectors.name: aw-execution-profile-bound
vectors.reason: An unsupported execution-profile interpretation is rejected before execution.

vectors.name: aw-valid-operation-graph
vectors.reason: The signed array uses only critical deterministic v1 kinds and forms a valid earlier-dependency execution graph.

vectors.name: aw-operation-id-max-length
vectors.reason: A 64-character operation ID is the last valid grammar length.

vectors.name: aw-operation-id-over-max-length
vectors.reason: A 65-character operation ID crosses the fixed grammar boundary.

vectors.name: aw-operation-id-grammar
vectors.reason: Operation IDs follow the fixed grammar.

vectors.name: aw-future-dependency-rejected
vectors.reason: Future/self/unknown dependencies are rejected before execution.

vectors.name: aw-critical-only
vectors.reason: All v1 effects participate in one critical business overlay.

vectors.name: aw-closed-operation-kind
vectors.reason: An HTTP-like external operation cannot enter the closed rollback-covered set.

vectors.name: aw-preflight-not-node-proof
vectors.reason: A client simulation cannot substitute for authenticated node capability.

vectors.name: aw-expiry-last-valid-millisecond
vectors.reason: Consensus may begin execution at the final millisecond strictly before expiresAt.

vectors.name: aw-expiry-equality-rejected-before-op
vectors.reason: At expiresAt equality the Work is expired and no operation executes.

vectors.name: aw-payload-schema-exact-profile
vectors.reason: The authenticated execution profile advertises and applies one exact v1 schema for every admitted operation kind.

vectors.name: aw-payload-schema-kind-missing
vectors.reason: A capability missing the native-transfer payload schema cannot admit the Purchase Work.

vectors.name: aw-payload-schema-version-unsupported
vectors.reason: An authenticated but unsupported payload-schema version fails before authorization or execution.

vectors.name: aw-payload-schema-no-caller-inference
vectors.reason: A missing signed transfer amount cannot be inferred from caller or SDK state.

vectors.name: aw-v1-purchase-roster-missing-buyer
vectors.reason: A dacs-purchase-v1 roster carries all four roles; dropping the buyer, who authorizes no Purchase operation, is rejected even under a recomputed workId.

vectors.name: aw-v1-purchase-roster-two-roles
vectors.reason: An ordered, unique orchestrator-and-payer roster still omits two of the four v1 roles.

vectors.name: aw-v1-completion-roster-missing-payer
vectors.reason: A dacs-completion-v1 roster carries all four roles; dropping the payer, who authorizes no Completion operation, is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-operation-id-duplicate
vectors.reason: Two operations cannot share an operationId even when the graph is otherwise valid.

vectors.name: aw-job-id-largest-128-bit
vectors.reason: The largest 128-bit ULID text form, first character 7, is a canonical JID-1 jobId.

vectors.name: aw-job-id-first-character-8
vectors.reason: A 26-character Crockford string starting with 8 encodes 130 bits and is a malformed JID-1 jobId, not a distinct session.

vectors.name: aw-job-id-first-character-9
vectors.reason: A 26-character Crockford string starting with 9 encodes 130 bits and is a malformed JID-1 jobId, not a distinct session.

vectors.name: aw-work-version-unsupported
vectors.reason: An intent with workVersion 2 is not AtomicDacsWorkIntentV1, whatever identifier its bytes derive.

vectors.name: aw-claim-parameter-list-empty
vectors.reason: A ClaimReference with an empty parameter list is not CF-2 canonical.

vectors.name: aw-claim-parameter-missing-equals
vectors.reason: A ClaimReference parameter without = is not CF-2 canonical.

vectors.name: aw-claim-parameter-lowercase-escape
vectors.reason: A lowercase percent-escape is not the CF-2 uppercase form and is not repaired.

vectors.name: aw-claim-parameter-reserved-unescaped
vectors.reason: A reserved character in a ClaimReference parameter value must be percent-escaped.

vectors.name: aw-capability-self-declared-authority
vectors.reason: A capability that names and signs its own networkAuthority is not authenticated by the independently pinned network authority.

vectors.name: aw-capability-attestation-for-other-capability
vectors.reason: A valid network attestation covers one exact capability; a capability differing in one limit is unattested.

vectors.name: aw-capability-version-unsupported
vectors.reason: An authenticated capability with capabilityVersion 2 is not AtomicWorkCapabilityV1.

vectors.name: aw-expiry-equality-after-first-operation
vectors.reason: At expiresAt equality the Work is expired even when a first operation is claimed to have executed.
